400 Bad Request when uploading a file with invalid purpose

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateFileRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\CreateFileRequest::from_json(json_encode(["file" => "data.jsonl", "purpose" => "invalid-purpose"]));
try {
    LiterLlm::createFile($req);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
